secoes.titulo: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões
5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês
1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência
3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão
4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The recycling program began as an experiment in two neighborhoods. It was eventually adopted throughout the county, but only after officials had reviewed the collection costs."

In this context, 'eventually' indicates that the program was adopted
alternativas: by chance, without official approval.
at regular intervals during the trial.
after a period of time and some intermediate steps.
before officials had examined any of the collection costs.
only as a temporary emergency measure.
questoes.explicacao: “Eventually” indica um desfecho alcançado depois de certo tempo, e o texto ainda menciona a análise prévia dos custos. Não exprime acaso, periodicidade, adoção antecipada nem medida emergencial.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The editor called the document 'a rather candid account' of the failed exhibition: it openly described scheduling mistakes instead of hiding them behind polished language."

The adjective 'candid' is closest in meaning to
alternativas: brief and incomplete.
formal and impersonal.
hostile and insulting.
uncertain and speculative.
frank and straightforward.
questoes.explicacao: “Candid” caracteriza um relato franco, que admite erros sem disfarces. A oposição a ocultar falhas confirma essa leitura. O adjetivo não indica brevidade, formalidade, hostilidade ou hesitação.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The plant manager insisted that the new filters were actually less expensive to maintain, contrary to what several suppliers had claimed during the negotiations."

The word 'actually' is used to
alternativas: correct a previous impression about maintenance costs.
show that maintenance costs are rising at present.
express a prediction that has not been tested.
introduce a condition imposed by suppliers during the negotiations.
emphasize that the filters are only theoretical.
questoes.explicacao: “Actually” significa 'na realidade' e introduz informação contrária ao que os fornecedores afirmavam. Não equivale a 'atualmente', nem anuncia previsão, condição contratual ou hipótese não testada.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Although the inspection team checked every room, it overlooked a small leak behind the storage tanks. The problem was discovered during a later maintenance visit."

The verb 'overlooked' means that the team
alternativas: deliberately approved the leak.
observed the leak from above.
repaired the leak immediately.
failed to notice the leak.
reported the leak in advance.
questoes.explicacao: “Overlooked” significa deixar de perceber ou não notar algo. A descoberta posterior confirma que o vazamento passou despercebido, sem implicar aprovação, observação elevada, reparo ou aviso prévio.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The university will roll out its digital identification cards gradually, beginning with new students and extending the service to all departments next semester."

The phrasal verb 'roll out' means to
alternativas: withdraw a system from public use.
introduce a new service in planned stages.
reduce the number of participating departments.
translate the cards into other languages.
replace a digital tool with a paper document.
questoes.explicacao: “Roll out” é lançar ou implementar um produto ou serviço, aqui de modo gradual. A ampliação planejada aos departamentos afasta os sentidos de retirar, restringir, traduzir ou substituir pelo papel.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"After the storm, the coastal laboratory resumed its measurements within two days. Researchers credited its resilient design, which had protected critical instruments from flooding."

In context, 'resilient' describes a design that
alternativas: requires constant replacement after any storm.
depends entirely on favorable weather.
withstands disruption and supports recovery.
delivers results only when the building is empty.
prevents all storms from approaching the coast.
questoes.explicacao: “Resilient” remete à capacidade de resistir a impactos e recuperar o funcionamento. A retomada rápida após a tempestade exemplifica essa propriedade, sem prometer ausência de danos ou controle do clima.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The new brochure promises effortless enrollment. For residents without internet access, however, this promise is a far cry from their experience of traveling to an office and waiting in line."

The expression 'a far cry from' conveys
alternativas: a close match between promise and reality.
a complaint about long-distance transportation only.
an instruction to speak louder at the office.
a gradual improvement in the brochure design.
a marked difference between the claim and reality.
questoes.explicacao: “A far cry from” marca grande distância figurada entre duas situações. A promessa de facilidade contrasta com deslocamentos e filas; não há equivalência, ordem para falar alto nem mera referência geográfica.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The figures in the annual report are sound: an independent reviewer checked the calculations and found no material inconsistencies in the underlying records."

Here, 'sound' most nearly means
alternativas: reliable and well founded.
audible at a considerable distance.
recorded in a public announcement.
unusually expensive to produce.
similar to spoken language.
questoes.explicacao: “Sound” qualifica dados sólidos e confiáveis, conforme a verificação independente. A palavra não se refere a som, volume de voz, anúncio público, custo de produção nem semelhança com a fala.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"SYSTEM RELEASE NOTE — Version 4.8 will stop supporting the legacy export format on 1 March. Files created before that date will remain readable, but new exports must use the updated format. No changes are required for stored files."

According to the release note, after 1 March users will still be able to
alternativas: create new exports using the legacy format.
edit stored files only after converting them.
delete all files produced before the update.
open files produced in the old format.
restore the legacy format by changing permissions.
questoes.explicacao: O comunicado distingue leitura de arquivos antigos e criação de novas exportações. Arquivos anteriores continuam legíveis, mas exportações novas usarão outro formato. Não se exige conversão nem exclusão.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"PROCUREMENT NOTICE — Suppliers must submit proof of insurance with their bids. Price and delivery time will be scored only for bids that meet this mandatory requirement. An attractive price cannot compensate for missing documentation."

Which conclusion follows from the notice?
alternativas: A missing certificate can be offset by much faster delivery under the notice.
A bid lacking proof of insurance will not reach scored evaluation.
Price is considered before the mandatory documents.
Only suppliers with the highest insurance coverage qualify.
Delivery time is the sole factor used to select a supplier.
questoes.explicacao: A prova de seguro é condição obrigatória de admissibilidade da proposta. Sem ela, preço e prazo sequer são pontuados. Não há compensação por rapidez ou menor preço, nem exigência de cobertura máxima.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"INCIDENT UPDATE — At 09:20, the monitoring system detected intermittent failures. At 09:45, engineers redirected traffic to a backup server. Service is now stable. The root cause has not yet been established."

Which statement is supported by the update?
alternativas: The defect was permanently repaired when monitoring first detected the issue.
The backup server caused the initial failures.
The service has stabilized although the underlying cause remains unknown.
Engineers are waiting for permission to redirect traffic.
The monitoring system was switched off at 09:45.
questoes.explicacao: O serviço está estável após o redirecionamento, mas a causa-raiz ainda é desconhecida. Estabilizar não equivale a eliminar definitivamente o defeito, tampouco identifica o servidor de apoio como origem.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"RECORDS MANAGEMENT RULE — Signed contracts are retained for six years after their expiration. While a legal hold is active, however, the destruction of relevant records must be suspended, even when the ordinary retention period has ended."

A contract has reached the end of its normal retention period but is subject to an active legal hold. The records officer should
alternativas: preserve it until the hold is lifted.
destroy it after receiving a routine reminder.
erase only its signed pages.
send it to the counterparty for disposal.
replace it with an unsigned summary.
questoes.explicacao: A ressalva do documento suspende a eliminação de registros alcançados por bloqueio jurídico ativo, inclusive depois do prazo ordinário. Um aviso rotineiro ou resumo sem assinatura não afasta tal preservação.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"LABORATORY PROCEDURE — Before taking samples, technicians shall verify the meter against a reference standard. If the deviation exceeds the accepted tolerance, the instrument must be recalibrated before use; otherwise, the verification result should be logged."

Which action is mandatory when the deviation is excessive?
alternativas: Proceed with sampling and mention the issue in the final report.
Lower the reference standard until the readings agree.
Discard the previous month of measurements automatically.
Repeat the readings without adjusting the instrument.
Recalibrate the meter before collecting samples.
questoes.explicacao: O procedimento impõe recalibração antes da coleta quando o desvio supera a tolerância. Apenas registrar o problema ou repetir leituras sem corrigir o instrumento não atende à exigência descrita.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"SERVICE DESK POLICY — Requests received after 5 p.m. are recorded immediately but enter the response queue on the next business day. Response targets are measured from queue entry, not from the original submission time."

A request submitted at 6 p.m. on a business day will have its response target calculated from
alternativas: 6 p.m. on the day of submission.
5 p.m. on the day of submission.
its entry into the queue on the following business day.
the time the requester opens the confirmation email.
the day on which the issue is finally resolved.
questoes.explicacao: Segundo a política, solicitações após as 17h são registradas de imediato, mas entram na fila no dia útil seguinte. O prazo de resposta começa nessa entrada, não no envio, no e-mail ou na solução.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"ACCESS CONTROL STANDARD — Staff members receive only the permissions needed for their current duties. Temporary privileges expire automatically after the approved task is completed, unless a new authorization is granted."

The standard primarily implements the principle that
alternativas: every employee should share the same permissions.
access should be restricted to what a job requires.
temporary privileges must remain in place indefinitely.
formal authorization is unnecessary for extra privileges.
new employees should receive the broadest access.
questoes.explicacao: A concessão limitada às necessidades da função expressa o princípio do menor privilégio. A expiração de acessos temporários reforça essa lógica, contrária a permissões amplas, eternas ou sem autorização.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"ENERGY AUDIT — The office consumed less electricity overall this quarter, partly because lights were upgraded. Nevertheless, the highest hourly demand rose on unusually hot afternoons, when several cooling systems operated simultaneously."

Which interpretation best reflects the audit?
alternativas: Both total consumption and peak demand necessarily fell during the quarter.
The lighting upgrade increased total electricity consumption.
Peak demand increased even though overall consumption decreased.
Cooling systems were turned off during the hottest periods.
The audit contains no information about demand patterns.
questoes.explicacao: O relatório diferencia consumo total de demanda máxima por hora. Houve economia acumulada com a iluminação, mas a demanda de pico cresceu em tardes quentes. As duas medidas não variam necessariamente juntas.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"At the maritime museum, visitors can book a guided tour on weekends. On weekdays, volunteers answer questions at the entrance, but there are no guided tours. The museum closes on Mondays, even during school holidays."

A visitor who wants a guided tour should plan to go
alternativas: on a Monday during a school holiday.
on any weekday when volunteers are present to answer questions at the entrance.
on a weekday morning before the museum opens.
on Monday if a volunteer agrees.
on a Saturday or Sunday when the museum is open.
questoes.explicacao: O texto reserva visitas guiadas aos fins de semana. Voluntários durante a semana respondem perguntas, mas não conduzem tours; às segundas, o museu fecha mesmo em férias escolares.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"To serve villages with unstable connections, the reading project lets users download books whenever they have internet access. Once a book is saved to the device, it can be opened without a connection. Updates still require access to the network."

What is the main practical advantage of the project for these villages?
alternativas: Previously downloaded books remain accessible offline.
New editions are delivered without any internet access.
All books are installed automatically before registration.
Every village receives a new telecommunications tower.
Users are no longer required to charge their devices.
questoes.explicacao: A vantagem é a leitura sem conexão de livros já baixados, solução pertinente a regiões com internet instável. O texto ressalva que atualizações exigem rede e não menciona torres, instalação automática ou energia.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"A clinic tested video consultations for routine follow-up appointments. Patients appreciated avoiding long journeys, but staff reported that the service was unsuitable for examinations requiring physical contact. The clinic therefore kept both remote and in-person appointments."

Which inference is best supported by the passage?
alternativas: Remote care made physical examinations unnecessary.
The clinic stopped offering appointments at its premises.
Travel time was the only criterion considered by the clinic.
The clinic adopted a mixed approach to meet different needs.
Patients preferred physical examinations in every case.
questoes.explicacao: A manutenção de atendimento remoto e presencial decorre de vantagens e limites distintos: economiza deslocamentos, mas não substitui exame físico. O texto sustenta uma solução híbrida, não exclusividade de modalidade.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Two neighborhoods planted the same number of young trees. Three summers later, survival rates were higher where residents watered the trees during the first dry season. Soil type and shade were not controlled in the comparison."

Which conclusion is most appropriately drawn?
alternativas: Watering was proved to be the sole cause of survival differences between neighborhoods.
Watering may have contributed, but other factors were not ruled out.
The neighborhoods had identical soil and shade conditions.
All young trees survived in the neighborhood with watering.
The results show that initial care has no possible effect.
questoes.explicacao: A maior sobrevivência coincide com a irrigação, mas o estudo não controlou solo nem sombra. Por isso, é legítimo apontar possível contribuição, não atribuir causalidade exclusiva ou afirmar igualdade entre locais.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"A small food cooperative used to lose many vegetables during transport. It recently added insulated containers, and the proportion of spoiled produce fell. The cooperative has not yet measured whether customer demand changed."

What can be established from the passage?
alternativas: The cooperative increased prices to pay for the containers.
Customer demand rose in direct proportion to sales.
Less produce was spoiled after the transport change.
All vegetables now arrive without a single defect.
The containers reduced the distance of delivery routes.
questoes.explicacao: O dado explícito é a queda da proporção de verduras estragadas após a introdução dos recipientes térmicos. Nada permite concluir sobre demanda, preços, distância percorrida ou eliminação total das perdas.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Applicants for the translation workshop must upload a short writing sample by Thursday. Those selected for interviews will receive invitations the following week. Submitting a sample does not guarantee an interview."

Which applicant has met the stated initial requirement?
alternativas: One who promises to send a sample after receiving an invitation.
One who calls the organizer but uploads no document.
One who submits a sample after the selection interviews.
One who sends a recommendation letter instead of a sample.
One who uploads the writing sample before Thursday's deadline.
questoes.explicacao: A exigência inicial é enviar uma amostra escrita até quinta-feira. O convite para entrevista depende de seleção posterior, logo não pode substituir o documento nem ser presumido pelo simples envio.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Before opening the mountain trail, park rangers inspected the bridges. One bridge required repairs, so the trail stayed closed for another week. The nearby visitor center remained open throughout that period."

Which statement is explicitly supported?
alternativas: The visitor center remained operational while the trail was closed.
The trail reopened immediately after its initial inspection.
Every bridge on the trail needed substantial reconstruction.
The park suspended all services during the repair work.
The closure was caused by insufficient visitor demand.
questoes.explicacao: O trecho afirma que o centro de visitantes permaneceu aberto durante a semana adicional de fechamento da trilha. O motivo informado é o reparo de uma ponte; não houve paralisação geral nem reabertura imediata.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"In a staff questionnaire, 72% of respondents requested shorter meetings, while 18% favored keeping the current schedule and 10% expressed no preference. The report notes that only employees who chose to respond were counted."

Which is the most careful interpretation of the figures?
alternativas: Precisely 72% of all employees oppose the current schedule.
The questionnaire proves that shorter meetings boost productivity.
Nonrespondents were counted among supporters of the current schedule, even though they completed no survey.
Most respondents favored shorter meetings, but workforce-wide preferences are uncertain.
Every employee who did not respond preferred longer meetings.
questoes.explicacao: Entre os respondentes, 72% pediram reuniões mais curtas. Como a participação foi voluntária, esse percentual não pode ser automaticamente projetado para todos os empregados, nem prova efeito na produtividade.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"By the time the visiting scientists arrived, the technicians had completed the safety checks. The group then entered the testing area without delay."

The verb phrase 'had completed' establishes that the checks
alternativas: were performed after the scientists entered.
had already finished before the scientists arrived.
were still in progress during the scientists' visit.
would be completed only on the following day.
were canceled because the scientists were late.
questoes.explicacao: O past perfect posiciona a conclusão das verificações antes da chegada dos cientistas, outro evento no passado. O texto não aponta continuidade, cancelamento ou execução posterior dos controles.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The engineer said, 'The readings might be inaccurate because the sensor was exposed to extreme heat. We need a second measurement before making a decision.'"

The modal verb 'might' expresses
alternativas: an obligation to disregard all readings.
a confirmed defect in every sensor.
a possibility that remains to be verified.
a prohibition against further measurement.
an ability that the sensor acquired in the past.
questoes.explicacao: “Might” comunica possibilidade, não certeza. A solicitação de nova medição reforça a necessidade de verificar a hipótese de inexatidão. Não há obrigação de descartar tudo, proibição nem capacidade adquirida.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"If the shipment had arrived before the exhibition opened, the organizers would have displayed the original sculpture. Instead, visitors saw a photographic reproduction."

The conditional construction indicates that
alternativas: the original sculpture was displayed as planned.
the shipment is expected before the next exhibition.
the original sculpture will certainly be shown tomorrow.
the exhibition was canceled before visitors arrived.
the shipment did not arrive in time for the intended display.
questoes.explicacao: O terceiro condicional apresenta hipótese contrária ao passado: a chegada em tempo não ocorreu, e por isso foi exibida uma reprodução. A construção não prevê o futuro nem indica que a mostra foi cancelada.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The proposal was reviewed by a committee of independent specialists before it was sent to the director."

Which statement accurately interprets the passive construction?
alternativas: An independent committee carried out the review.
The director personally reviewed the proposal first.
The proposal reviewed the independent specialists.
The committee received the proposal only after the director.
Nobody was responsible for examining the proposal.
questoes.explicacao: Na voz passiva, 'the proposal' recebe a ação, enquanto 'by a committee' identifica quem fez a revisão. A ordem temporal também é explícita: primeiro a comissão, depois o envio à direção.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The library extended evening hours last year. Since then, attendance has increased steadily, although weekend figures have remained almost unchanged."

The present perfect in 'has increased' suggests that the increase
alternativas: was limited to one completed evening on a single day last year.
will begin only after the next timetable change.
occurred entirely before the extension of hours.
began in the past and remains relevant up to the present.
applies equally to weekday and weekend attendance.
questoes.explicacao: O present perfect vincula uma evolução iniciada no passado ao período que chega ao presente. “Since then” marca o ponto inicial; o texto ainda diferencia o crescimento geral da estabilidade aos fins de semana.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Neither the original invoice nor the attached receipts were available when the audit began. The finance officer requested duplicate copies from the suppliers."

The opening sentence communicates that
alternativas: the invoice was available but the receipts were not.
both the invoice and the receipts were unavailable.
the receipts were available but the invoice was missing.
every supplier had already sent duplicate copies.
the auditor decided not to request any documents.
questoes.explicacao: A estrutura correlativa “neither ... nor” nega a disponibilidade dos dois elementos. A solicitação de segundas vias confirma a falta dos documentos, sem afirmar que já tenham sido entregues.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The coordinator asked the translators to review the terminology list before submitting their drafts. She explained that this would reduce inconsistencies across the final report."

In context, the pronoun 'this' refers chiefly to
alternativas: submitting drafts without any revision.
the publication of the final report.
reviewing the terminology list before submission.
the appointment of a different coordinator.
the cancellation of translation deadlines.
questoes.explicacao: “This” retoma a ação descrita na frase anterior: revisar a lista terminológica antes da entrega. É esse cuidado que tende a diminuir inconsistências; não há referência a cancelamento ou troca de coordenação.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Provided that the equipment passes the final inspection, it will be shipped on Friday. If any serious defect is found, delivery will be postponed."

The expression 'provided that' introduces
alternativas: a reason why the equipment was inspected yesterday.
a contrast between two completed shipments.
an assurance that shipment will happen regardless of defects.
a description of how the equipment was manufactured.
a condition that must be fulfilled for Friday's shipment.
questoes.explicacao: “Provided that” equivale a 'desde que' e estabelece a aprovação na inspeção como condição para expedição na sexta-feira. A possibilidade de adiamento afasta qualquer garantia incondicional de entrega.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The prototype performed well in controlled trials. However, its parts are expensive and difficult to replace in remote areas. For these reasons, the authors recommend further field testing before large-scale deployment."

What is the main function of 'However' in the passage?
alternativas: To introduce limitations that qualify the favorable trial results.
To announce a second experiment with identical findings.
To specify the date on which the product will be launched.
To explain that replacement parts are now inexpensive.
To conclude that field testing is no longer necessary.
questoes.explicacao: “However” introduz oposição entre bom desempenho experimental e dificuldades práticas de manutenção. A concessão sustenta cautela antes da adoção em larga escala, em vez de negar os testes ou anunciar lançamento.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Who benefits when a city's data are open but impossible for ordinary residents to understand? The answer is not simply to publish more spreadsheets; institutions must also provide clear explanations and accessible tools."

The opening question is mainly used to
alternativas: request a numerical estimate of spreadsheet downloads.
suggest that public data should never be released.
ask residents to identify every municipal employee.
challenge the assumption that mere publication ensures accessibility.
claim that all existing data are intentionally incorrect.
questoes.explicacao: A pergunta retórica problematiza a ideia de que disponibilizar dados já os torna acessíveis. A sequência defende explicações e ferramentas compreensíveis, não a proibição da divulgação nem uma consulta estatística.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The laboratory's archive is a map of decisions made over decades: every revised protocol points to a problem that researchers once had to solve."

The metaphor 'a map of decisions' emphasizes that the archive
alternativas: contains only geographical information about the location of various laboratories.
helps readers trace the history and direction of past choices.
proves that earlier decisions were all mistaken.
is a literal diagram drawn on the laboratory wall.
can replace every current research procedure.
questoes.explicacao: “Map of decisions” é metáfora para um registro que permite acompanhar escolhas e mudanças ao longo do tempo. A referência aos protocolos revisados não transforma o acervo em mapa geográfico nem invalida o passado.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Automated summaries can save time, and some evaluations are promising. Yet most studies have tested short, well-structured documents. Whether similar gains appear in complex legal files remains an open question."

The author's tone is best described as
alternativas: unreservedly enthusiastic about all applications.
dismissive of any benefit from automation.
angry at researchers for using short documents.
certain that legal files will yield identical results.
cautiously receptive while noting limits in the evidence.
questoes.explicacao: O autor reconhece benefícios e resultados promissores, mas ressalta limitações das pesquisas disponíveis. O tom é receptivo e prudente, sem entusiasmo irrestrito, rejeição absoluta ou certeza sobre documentos jurídicos.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"CORRECTION NOTICE — An earlier newsletter stated that the pedestrian bridge would reopen in June. The revised date is August, following additional structural tests. We apologize for the error and will post further updates on the project page."

The primary communicative purpose of the notice is to
alternativas: persuade readers to abandon the bridge project.
invite volunteers to perform structural inspections.
correct previously published information and explain the change.
announce that the bridge has already reopened in June.
present a technical comparison of bridge materials.
questoes.explicacao: O aviso corrige a data divulgada anteriormente, explica a alteração com testes adicionais e pede desculpas. Seu objetivo central é retificar a informação, não convocar voluntários nem anunciar reabertura ocorrida.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"At first, the team mapped the existing workflow. Next, it removed repeated approval steps. Finally, it monitored processing times for three months to assess whether the redesign worked."

The passage is organized primarily through
alternativas: a chronological sequence of actions.
a comparison between competing research theories.
a definition followed by unrelated examples.
a debate presenting two opposing speakers.
a classification of documents by legal status.
questoes.explicacao: As marcas “At first”, “Next” e “Finally” ordenam etapas de um processo de revisão do fluxo de trabalho. A progressão é temporal e procedimental, não uma discussão de teorias ou classificação documental.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Early figures suggest that the new scheduling system may reduce missed appointments. The report does not claim a definitive effect, because the trial involved only one facility and lasted six weeks."

The choice of 'suggest' and 'may' primarily serves to
alternativas: state that the system definitely has no effect.
turn preliminary evidence into a universal law.
attribute missed appointments solely to staff errors.
signal uncertainty and avoid overstating the findings.
guarantee identical outcomes in every institution.
questoes.explicacao: “Suggest” e “may” modalizam a conclusão, indicando indícios e possibilidade. Como o teste foi curto e restrito a uma unidade, o relatório evita generalização ou afirmação causal definitiva.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"The neighborhood theater does not lack talent; it lacks rehearsal space. Its actors have won regional awards, but they still practice in borrowed classrooms and cancel sessions when those rooms are unavailable."

The first sentence uses contrast mainly to
alternativas: argue that the theater's artistic prizes are meaningless and never reflect talent.
identify facilities, rather than artistic ability, as the main obstacle.
claim that the actors are unwilling to rehearse.
suggest that rehearsals should be abolished.
present talent and available rooms as equally abundant.
questoes.explicacao: O contraste “does not lack ...; it lacks ...” desloca o foco da capacidade artística para a falta de espaço. Prêmios e ensaios interrompidos sustentam essa leitura, sem desqualificar atores ou sugerir acabar com ensaios.
